subtitle: Yuanming Yuan

model.line: A plain box on the block drawn on the Qing plan S01: position and frontage from the plan, heights and roof from the typology of its hall class. It will be updated as the research goes on.

evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 映水兰香
evidence.excerpt_zh: 澹泊寧静度河橋而西為映水蘭香西向五楹東南為釣魚磯北為印月池池北為知耕織又北稍東為濯鱗沼映水蘭香西南為貴織山堂祀蠶神（圓明園册）臣等謹按映水蘭香四十景之一額為皇上御書釣魚磯印月池知耕織濯鱗沼貴織山堂諸額皆世宗御書
evidence.summary: West across the stream: 映水蘭香, five bays facing west, with the 釣魚磯, 印月池, 知耕織, 濯鱗沼 and 貴織山堂, a shrine to the silkworm spirit.

evidence.title: 世宗 耕織軒 (園景十二詠)
evidence.date: before 1723 (雍邸集, printed as written while a prince)
evidence.excerpt_zh:
耕織軒
軒亭開面面原隰對畇畇禾稼迎窓緑桑麻窣地新簷星窺織火渠水界田畛辛苦農蠶事歌詩可繋豳
evidence.summary: Prince's poem on a pavilion open on all sides over fields of grain and mulberry. Tied by inference to 映水蘭香, which has the plaque 知耕織.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum and Historical Photographs of China; today's photographs on Commons.

plan_ref.text: Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01) with no label, 1x3 cells: a building stood here, its name unknown.
